Full pass over the 17-page summary report. Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 3). Loaded: for five industrial applications (iron and steel, cement, natural gas processing, fertiliser, bioethanol) the capture-and-compression (CC) plant capex (Total Plant Cost), variable and fixed O&M and annual CO2 flow (Tables D, E) on capture-unit_amine (dilute streams) or compressor_co2-dehydration (pure streams), with capex per t-per-yr derived; and the whole facility with CCS (host) rows: emission intensity, incremental levelised cost of product with CCS FOAK and NOAK, cost of CO2 avoided FOAK and NOAK (Table 1) and Canada FOAK (Table 2). NGCC with and without capture from Table C (power-sector rule: combined cycle only); coal PC, USC, IGCC and oxy-combustion power plants (Table B, C) skipped as power-only coal. Traps: industrial "levelised cost with CCS" in Table 1 is the INCREMENT per unit of product, not the full product cost (the without-CCS row is a market price analogue); industrial O&M in Table E is a 3% + 3% rule of thumb, energy not separated; Table E costs cover capture AND compression (CC) with no split; cost of CO2 avoided includes transport and storage (11 US$/t industrial; 7-12 power); fertiliser reference is the Coffeyville coke-gasification ammonia plant, not an SMR; gas processing levelised cost is per GJ of gas. Price year: constant 2015 US$ (Table A). No energy per t CO2 is printed for the industrial capture plants.
